steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM at http://127.0.0.1:8097/ using username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the authenticated app is open and report the visible page.
02-find: In the Opportunities list, find and report the exact names of all opportunities whose name starts with 'Seed:'. Do not edit any records.

03-create: Create an opportunity named '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', link it to the existing account named 'Bench Account' by choosing the actual matching record from suggestions or a select dialog, and set a description that includes the exact runid {{runid}}. Save the record and verify its displayed name, linked account, and description.
04-edit: Edit the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' and set its stage to 'Negotiation'. Save, then verify the displayed stage on the record.

05-edit: Edit the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' and set Amount to 12500 in the default currency and {{03-create.close_date_field_label}} to 2026-12-31. Save and verify both values on the record detail page.

06-edit: Edit the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' and assign it to the existing user 'Bench Assignee'. Select the actual matching user record from suggestions or the select dialog, save, and verify the displayed assignee.

07-verify: On the Stream for opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', publish a post whose text includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Submit it and verify the posted text is visible in this opportunity's Stream.
persistence: re-read what the flow saved
